Edmond Tuesday Casual Ride

Edmond, OK · Downtown Edmond · Social

No-dropBeginner friendly

Edmond Tuesday Casual Ride is a social group ride in Edmond, OK. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:16 pm from Edmond City Hall. About 8–10 miles, 8–10 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:16 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8–10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Edmond Tuesday Casual Ride group ride

A short, slow no-drop ride from Edmond City Hall. Eight to 10 miles at 8 to 10 mph. Built for people who are new to riding in a group. Summer season only.
